contexts.text: Levi = charity; and therefore the tribe of Levi received the priesthood, and represented the shepherd of the flock.
(Hence) the tribe of Levi loveborn, and was made the priesthood ().
Levi, in the supreme sense, = the Lord; and thence the man who has love and charity; and therefore the covenant of lives and of peace with Levi () = [that] in love and charity. AC 1286:4. AC 2826:7.

As the first-born represented the Lord; and those who are the Lord's are so from love to Him, therefore the tribe of Levi was accepted in place of all the first-born; and this because Levi represented the Lord as to love. Levi also = love; for Levi means adhesion and conjunction...
These four degrees are signified by... Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah.
The tribe of Levi = love... Hence the rod of Levi only blossomed ().
Levi was so called from adhering. AC 3875:6. AR 357.
By Levi is signified spiritual love, or charity.
The progression is thence... to charity, which is Levi...
Faith in the will, when it becomes charity, is Levi.
Levi (here) = an affection contrary to charity.
Those who are in spiritual love are called sons of Levi ().
That, in the supreme sense, the Lord is Levi, from His Divine love and mercy towards those who are in spiritual love (is evident from) .
And as the Divine love or mercy of the Lord is meant, in the supreme sense, by Levi; and, in the internal sense, spiritual love; therefore the tribe of Levi was made the priesthood...
This mutual love, or charity towards the neighbour, is what is meant by spiritual love, and is what is signified by Levi.

She called his name Levi () = its quality... This quality is what is signified by Levi, and also by the tribe named from him; and it is this third universal of the Church, or the third universal when man is being regenerated... and it is charity. Explained.

Simeon and Levi () = faith and love... Levi = spiritual love, or charity. In the genuine sense, these things are signified by Simeon and Levi, and also by the tribes named from Simeon and Levi; but, in the opposite sense, falsity and evil... Relatively to the Jewish nation... Simeon and Levi represent these, (in that) they killed Hamor, Shechem, and the men of the city... Simeon and Levi did this in order that it might be represented that the truth of faith and the good of charity had become falsity and evil... AC 4499. AC 4502:2. AC 4502:3. Explained.

To Simeon and Levi () = what is representative of spiritual and celestial things... Levi = love; but, in the opposite sense, evil; here, therefore, what is representative of... celestial things. Explained.
Under Judah, see this reference.
In the supreme sense, Levi = love and mercy; in the internal sense, charity or spiritual love; and, in the external sense, conjunction. References.
(The blossoming of the almonds) was a sign that the tribe of Levi had been chosen for the priesthood, because by it was signified charity, which is the essential of the Spiritual Church.
The sons of Levi, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari () = spiritual love, and its doctrinal things in general. AC 7230:2.
Simeon and Levi are brethren () = faith in the will, and charity; here, what is contrary, because [they = ] faith separated from charity. Explained.
Therefore, by Levi is represented evil in act; for this is opposite to charity.

There went a man of the house of Levi () = the origin of truth from good... Levi represents good; for, in the supreme sense, Levi represents the Divine love; and, in the internal sense, spiritual love; and, as he represents love, he represents good; for all good is of love.
And took a daughter of Levi () = conjunction with good. Explained.
Afterwards (in ) there is described the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom as to faith and as to charity... Levi and his families represent the things which are of charity.
These are the families of Levi according to their births () = that these things are goods and truths from charity.
The reason why Reuben, Simeon, and Levi, and their sons, are here mentioned, and not the rest of the fathers of the tribes with their sons. Explained.

Finally, in the (new) will (of the man of the Spiritual Church) there is apperceived the affection of charity; so that he wills to do what is good, not, as before, from faith, but from charity towards the neighbour... It is this charity with its affection which is represented by Levi.
Faith separated from charity is described by... Simeon and Levi, in that they killed Hamor... and were therefore cursed by their father.
The sons of Levi () = those who are of the Spiritual Church; for by Levi is signified charity, or spiritual good. AC 9293:end.
The sons of Levi, who congregated to Moses, () = those who are in truths from good, (which is the same as being in charity). AC 10485. AC 10491.
Levi = truth in act, which is the good of life; and therefore the priesthood was given to his posterity.
By Reuben, Simeon, and Levi... are signified truth in the understanding, or faith; truth in the will, or charity; and truth in act, or good work; the like as by Peter, James, and John.

From the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand () = the affection of truth from good from which is intelligence with those who will be of the Lord's New Heaven and New Church. By Levi, in the supreme sense, is signified love and mercy; in the spiritual sense, charity in act, which is the good of life; and, in the natural sense, consociation and conjunction; for he was so called from to adhere, by which... is signified conjunction through love. But here, by Levi is signified the love or affection of truth, and the derivative intelligence; because he follows Simeon, and is the middle one in this series. As Levi represented these things, that tribe was made the priesthood. Illustrated. That the tribe of Levi = the love of truth, which is the very love from which the Church is the Church, and the derivative intelligence. Illustrated.

To purify the sons of Levi = to purify those who are in the affection of truth. As this affection blossoms from intelligence, the rod of Levi, upon which was written the name of Aaron, blossomed with almonds ().
See Espalier.
The tribe of Levi was the first of the tribes, because Levi represented the good of charity; and therefore this tribe was made the priesthood, (which) is the first of the Church, References.
The sons of Levi = all who are in the good of charity, and thence in the truths of faith...

As the sons of Levi were set over Divine worship, and all Divine worship takes place from spiritual good and from the truths thence, it is said that Jehovah chose them to minister to Him, and to bless in the name of Jehovah ()...
Levi = all who are in the good of charity towards the neighbour; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord Himself, because this good is from Him; here, () the Lord Himself. References.
The obedience of faith is signified by... (the tribes of) Simeon, Levi, and Issachar.
The tribes of Simeon, Levi, and Issachar, who... constitute the third class of the sealed, = those who are in the First Heaven... Explained.
Simeon and Levi are brethren = faith separated from charity.

The reason his first three sons, Reuben, Simeon, and Levi, were rejected and condemned by their father Israel, is that in that prophecy it treats of the instauration of the Church... and by Levi is there signified no good of charity... Explained.
From the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand = good works... because charity consists in the performance of goods. Explained.
The reason the priesthood was given to the tribe of Levi, was that it represented love and charity...
As the tribe of Levi represented charity in act, thus the goods of charity...

As the good of charity must be in all things of the Church... and because the affection itself of good and truth... gives to understand, and instructs all, the tribe of Levi was not only made the priesthood, but there was also no inheritance given to it... (; ).
The sons of Levi () = the affection of good and truth, which is charity.
That the tribe of Levi = the goods of charity, which are good works. Illustrated.
The sons of Levi () = all who are in the good of charity, and thence in the good of faith. Explained.
By Levi () is meant the affection of spiritual truth, Explained.
That Levi = love and charity. Illustrated.
Levi means adhesion; and adhesion = conjunction through spiritual love.

The three sons of Leah, born in order = Reuben, Simeon, and Levi, = the first and primary essentials of the Church in their series; namely, truth in the understanding, truth in the will, and truth in act; in like manner as the Lord's three disciples...

That Levi, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to love and mercy, is evident from... . By Levi, here, in the supreme sense, is meant the Lord as to the Divine Human. Explained... And therefore by the covenant of Levi is meant conjunction with the Lord through love and charity, AE 696:16, AE 701:9.

Levi, and his tribe, in the opposite sense, = the evil of falsity, which is opposite to the good of charity; and also life without charity, consequently, no charity towards the neighbour. Illustrated.
The sons of Levi () = those who are in the truths of spiritual good.
Levi (. 13) = the good of charity.
For the Lord is meant by Levi, as He is by David; but by Levi, as to the Divine good, which is the Lord's priestly [office], Explained.
